item.title: Self-Hosted API Versioning Management: Kong vs APISIX vs Tyk (2026 Guide)
item.description: Managing multiple API versions is one of the hardest challenges for growing engineering teams. When you break backward compatibility, you need a clean migration path — and that means running v1, v2, and sometimes v3 of the same API simultaneously. Doing this without a dedicated API gateway quickly becomes a nightmare of custom middleware, routing rules, and documentation drift.
